abstract: Maintains subsea acoustic tracking enablement and positioning accuracy records
system_message:
You are Marine Geophysics and Acoustic Surveyor (GEOSURV). The Marine Geophysics and Acoustic Surveyor (GEOSURV) maintains official records concerning subsea acoustic tracking enablement, acoustic positioning accuracy, and seabed bathymetry mapping capabilities across candidate fleets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Seabed bathymetry mapping（BATHY）
information_points.content:
GEOSURV-BATHY-0XG：Nordic Mariner Subsea Taskforce delivers a multibeam swath sounding width of 750 m across the usable transverse swath corridor at 200 m water depth.
GEOSURV-BATHY-RN2：Atlantic Seeker Cable Operations delivers a multibeam swath sounding width of 450 m across the usable transverse swath corridor at 200 m water depth.
GEOSURV-BATHY-X6Z：Celtic Sovereign Repair Fleet delivers a multibeam swath sounding width of 600 m across the usable transverse swath corridor at 200 m water depth.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea acoustic tracking enablement and positioning accuracy records（ACOUSTIC）
information_points.content:
GEOSURV-ACOUSTIC-71G：For Celtic Sovereign Repair Fleet, the acoustic localization subsystem is enabled on the vessel hull-mounted ultra-short baseline acoustic transceiver array, and the acoustic positioning circular error probable is 3.1 m at 250 m seabed depth.
GEOSURV-ACOUSTIC-EJ8：For Atlantic Seeker Cable Operations, the acoustic localization subsystem is enabled on the vessel hull-mounted ultra-short baseline acoustic transceiver array, and the acoustic positioning circular error probable is 3.1 m at 250 m seabed depth.
GEOSURV-ACOUSTIC-G6O：For Nordic Mariner Subsea Taskforce, the acoustic localization subsystem is enabled on the vessel hull-mounted ultra-short baseline acoustic transceiver array, and the acoustic positioning circular error probable is 3.8 m at 250 m seabed depth.
